pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Frostsoul Jade forms when ancient cold essence seeps into stone and crystallizes over countless winters. Its translucent body carries a deep, lingering chill. Deposits are found in frozen landscapes, where snow and ice endure throughout the seasons.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Search snowy plains and slopes, ice spikes, frozen rivers and oceans, frozen peaks, and groves, starting between Y −32 and 80.
